_about: Public-domain A. B. Bruce (Alexander Balmain Bruce, 1831-1899, Free Church of Scotland, professor of apologetics and New Testament exegesis at the Free Church College, Glasgow) for the Word Hoard: The Training of the Twelve clean from CCEL, and The Humiliation of Christ (second edition, 1889), The Parabolic Teaching of Christ (fourth edition, 1891), The Kingdom of God (1889), St. Paul's Conception of Christianity (1896 printing) and The Epistle to the Hebrews (1899) as raw Internet Archive OCR.
